Left or right boundary of a time range.

## Variants
#### `CursorRelative` = 1
Type: non-null [`TimeInt`](../encodings/time_int.md)

Boundary is a value relative to the time cursor.

#### `Absolute` = 2
Type: non-null [`TimeInt`](../encodings/time_int.md)

Boundary is an absolute value.

#### `Infinite` = 3
Type: `null`

The boundary extends to infinity.
